title: Aming Mga Kliyente
subtitle: Mga Success Story
description: Tingnan kung paano nakakamit ng mga negosyong katulad mo ang resulta gamit ang aming solusyon.

clients.name: Portia Grid
clients.shortDescription: Komprehensibong web platform para pamahalaan ang delivery truck fleets at maintenance schedules.
clients.fullDescription: Ang Portia Grid ay malakas na internal tool na tumutulong sa logistics companies na pamahalaan ang buong delivery fleet.
clients.challenge: Pinamamahalaan ng client ang 50+ trucks gamit ang spreadsheets at tawag. Madalas na-mi-miss ang maintenance, nagkakaroon ng breakdowns at delays.
clients.solution: Bumuo kami ng custom web platform — real-time GPS tracking, automated maintenance scheduling, driver management, comprehensive reporting.

testimonial.quote: Karamihan sa devs ay binubuo lang ang sinasabi mo; ang team na ito ay talagang nag-iisip ng logic kasama mo. Napakahusay nina Mohamed, Asad, at Ariyan sa Portia Grid.
testimonial.author: Hassan

clients.name: Iyat
clients.shortDescription: Modern at visually rich website para sa Iyat — creative portfolio at services showcase.
clients.fullDescription: We designed and built a premium portfolio website for Iyat, a digital agency specializing in creative marketing solutions.
clients.challenge: Kailangan ng Iyat ng propesyonal na online presence para makaakit ng bagong kliyente.
clients.solution: Bumuo kami ng sleek portfolio website — smooth animations, responsive design, engaging UX.
